note: One short tip per word on the official reading list (content/vocab/reading-vocabulary.json), shown after a learner misses that word in Read it practice. Keys are lowercase words without punctuation. Only "reviewed" tips are shown; change "draft" to "reviewed" after checking a tip. Tips are about saying the word, never about the civics answer.

abraham.tip: Say it in three parts: A-bra-ham.

washington.tip: Say it in three parts: WASH-ing-ton.

american.tip: Say it in four parts: a-MER-i-can.

flag.tip: Say "flag": "fl" + a short "a" + "g". It rhymes with "bag".

bill.tip: Say "bil", with a short "i". It rhymes with "fill".

capital.tip: Say it in three parts: CAP-i-tal.

citizen.tip: Say it in three parts: CIT-i-zen. It starts with an "s" sound.

city.tip: Say "SIT-ee". It starts with an "s" sound.

congress.tip: Say "KONG-gress". Put the stress on the first part.

father.tip: Say "FAH-ther". Put your tongue between your teeth for "th".

government.tip: Say it in three parts: GUV-ern-ment.

president.tip: Say it in three parts: PREZ-i-dent.

presidents.tip: Say it in three parts and end with "s": PREZ-i-dents.

senators.tip: Say it in three parts: SEN-a-tors.

america.tip: Say it in four parts: a-MER-i-ca.

united.tip: Say it in three parts: you-NI-ted.

day.tip: Say "day" with a long "a": "d-AY". It rhymes with "say".

memorial.tip: Say it in four parts: me-MOR-ee-al.

independence.tip: Say it in four parts: in-de-PEN-dence.

columbus.tip: Say it in three parts: co-LUM-bus.

thanksgiving.tip: Say it in three parts: thanks-GIV-ing. Put your tongue between your teeth for "th".

why.tip: Say "wy" ("w" + "eye"). It sounds like the letter "Y".

can.tip: Say "kan", with a short "a". It rhymes with "man".

elects.tip: Say it in two parts and finish the "cts": e-LECTS.

name.tip: Say "naym", with a long "a". It rhymes with "same".

pay.tip: Say "pay" with a long "a": "p-AY". It rhymes with "day".

vote.tip: Say "vote". Touch your top teeth to your lip for "v".

largest.tip: Say it in two parts: LARJ-est.

north.tip: Say "north". Put your tongue between your teeth for "th".

south.tip: Say "south". Put your tongue between your teeth for "th".

one.tip: Say "wun". It sounds like the number 1.

the.tip: Put your tongue between your teeth for "th": "the".

of.tip: Say "uv". It sounds like "v" at the end.
